answers.core: It's a simple feature with the existing functionality already (theoretically) exposed to the runtime.  A UI element for it in the editor simply doesn't exist yet, as far as I can tell.
answers.workaround: Yes.  `TileSet.remove_tile(id)` exists.  It's not clear if the underlying implementation re-orders IDs or just makes the existing one invalid.  It's also unclear if the ID will be "recycled" by the built-in TileSet editor.
